name: HoneyFactory brand assets
generator: OpenAI gpt-image-2.5-sunburst / flare + PIL post-processing; prompts in docs/brand/prompts.md
notes: Paths under /brand/ are served from web/public/brand (Vite public dir).
Use the -dark variant when html.dark is set; light backgrounds are #f9f7f4, dark #15181c (html.dark body).
@2x files are for high-DPI: (hero/whatsnew @2x are WebP, empty-state @2x are PNG). welcome-hero@2x is upscaled from a 2304 px source.
Course covers have their own light background and work on either theme.
Entries whose path does not start with /brand/ are repo-relative (desktop/build, docs/brand, web/public/logo.png).
Mark sizes: <=32 px use the hand-pixelled simplified mark (logo-mark-32, favicon 16/32, tray, ico 16/24/32); >=48 px use the full mark. Mark fill #d99528 (small sizes #ce841e).
